summary: This bill rescinds unobligated funds previously allocated for electric vehicle charging and fueling grants and the National Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Formula Program, redirecting these funds to the general fund of the Treasury for deficit reduction.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly rescinds unobligated balances from electric vehicle charging and fueling grant programs and deposits them into the general fund for deficit reduction. This directly reduces government spending.

By rescinding funds for electric vehicle charging infrastructure, the bill removes support for technologies that reduce greenhouse gas emissions, thereby indirectly hindering efforts towards environmental protection related to climate change. This is a central aspect of the bill's purpose.

The bill rescinds unobligated balances from EV charging and national electric vehicle grants, explicitly depositing the funds into the Treasury 'for the sole purpose of deficit reduction.' This is the central and sole purpose of the legislation, making it a direct effort to shrink the deficit by cutting spending.
